content_of_post_to_comment: Europe doesn’t have a lack of ideas. European Security Council. Defence Union. Capital Markets Union. Energy Union. Strategic autonomy. The much bigger problem is turning ideas into decisions. What do you think is the ONE reform the EU needs most?
comment: Perhaps the EU needs a default rule for inaction: if member states can't agree unanimously by a deadline, a qualified majority decides. The real question is how to make flexibility politically acceptable.
